name: Apprise
description: One API to send notifications to over 100 services

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Your saved notification configurations, with the service URLs and their keys. Keep it private.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Apprise web page and API, published on host as 6821

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: APPRISE_STATEFUL_MODE
variables.description: simple saves each configuration you make in the web page, so other apps can notify by its key. Set to disabled to only accept URLs sent with each message.
